reports.headline: Two qualifiers: Quantum (QMCO) +43% revenue and no debt; Venture Global (VG) +43% with raised EBITDA guide
reports.summary: Quantum beat estimates with revenue up 43% and adj. EBITDA up sharply, and has cleared its debt; the main caveat is a warrant-driven GAAP loss. Venture Global grew revenue 43% and raised its full-year EBITDA guide but carries ~$44.6B of debt. Digital Turbine grew 27% and raised its revenue guide but is down ~25% pre-market on margins, while October CPI came in hotter than expected.
reports.html:
Finalists

QMCO Quantum Corp · pre-market ~$19.6–19.8 +15–16%

FQ2 2027 (Sep qtr): revenue $89.6M, +42.9% YoY (est. $82.2M, beat). Non-GAAP EPS $0.25 vs $0.12 est. Gross margin 41.0% (+340 bp). Adj. EBITDA $11.1M vs $0.5M a year ago. No debt (term loan and $90M convert cleared since March); cash $67.5M; record backlog ~$100M.

Guidance: FQ3 revenue $91M ±$2M, adj. EPS $0.20 ±$0.10, adj. EBITDA $9.1M.

Red flags: GAAP net loss $44.8M ($-1.14/sh) from a $51.6M non-cash warrant fair-value charge, so warrants are a dilution overhang. The stock is not beaten down: it rallied hard after the August report and is now at the top of the price range. Option liquidity not checked.

VG Venture Global · pre-market ~$12.44 +5%

Q3 2026: revenue $4.76B, +43% YoY. Diluted EPS $0.96 vs $0.16. Consolidated adj. EBITDA $2.58B (+69%).

Guidance: FY26 adj. EBITDA raised to $10.0–10.3B (from $8.7–9.1B); cargo range 509–518.

Red flags: very heavy debt, about $44.6B total (up from ~$34.2B at year-end) to fund build-out. Earnings depend on LNG prices and fees. Analyst EPS estimate not verified.

Near-miss

APPS Digital Turbine · ~-25% pre-market

Revenue $178.7M, +27% (beat $166.7M); GAAP EPS $0.06 (vs $-0.20 loss); adj. EPS $0.18 vs $0.16; adj. EBITDA +46%. FY27 revenue raised to $670–690M, but EBITDA guide held at $145–155M. Shares fell on disappointing margins. Also: ~$344M long-term debt, and a prior-quarter revision for understated revenue-share expense. Pre-market price not verified.

Larger movers & macro

Up pre-market: SANM (+14–19%, revenue +84%), TTD (~+23% after hours), AAON (+15–18%, raised outlook), ONTO (+9% after hours). Down: RKLB (~-8%, wider loss), ONON (~-8%), QLYS (~-8% despite a raise), HIMS lower. TTWO +3.6% on GTA VI pre-orders.

Macro: October CPI ran hot, +0.4% headline and +0.3% core (est. 0.3%/0.2%), which supports December Fed hike expectations. Nasdaq futures lagged after a report on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Oil fell to its lowest since late August.

Option quotes before 9:30am ET are stale; implied volatility typically drops after earnings.

reports.headline: Light Monday: nothing qualifies; Kamada profitable but growth too slow
reports.summary: Mondays are light. The only cheap reporter found, Kamada, is profitable with raised guidance but grows only ~11%. Friday after-close reports and small-cap movers pages could not be retrieved, so a small name may have been missed.
reports.html:

  • Net income $8M (+51%); adj. EBITDA $15.2M (+30%, 29% margin)
  • Raised 2026 guidance to $205–208M revenue, $52–54M adj. EBITDA; 2027 guidance due in January

reports.headline: No clean pass; Grindr closest, Compass and SoundHound fail
reports.summary: No cheap name clearly passed every filter after Thursday's close and this morning's open. Grindr came closest on growth and guidance but likely trades above the $15 cutoff. The backdrop was a heavy tech selloff (Nasdaq −5.5% Thursday, VIX ~28).
reports.html:
Closest to qualifying

GRND · Grindr · price not confirmed (~$16.60 in August)
  • Q3 revenue $141.4M, +22% YoY, organic (PurposeMed closed after quarter-end)
  • Adj. EBITDA $61.7M, 43.7% margin (down from 47.4%)
  • Raised 2026 guidance to ~$560M revenue / ~$236M adj. EBITDA; initial 2027 outlook ≥$705M revenue (~26% growth), ≥$275M EBITDA
  • Red flags: GAAP net loss −$6.6M driven by a $32.3M litigation charge; interest expense ~$6.8M/qtr; likely above the $15 price cutoff; EPS vs. estimate (~$0.17) not confirmed

Cheap names that failed the filter

  • COMP (Compass), ~$9.25: revenue $3.9B (+111%) is merger-driven (organic ~+7%); EPS beat ($0.07 vs $0.04) but Q4 revenue and EBITDA guidance below consensus; $3.1B long-term debt
  • SOUN (SoundHound): revenue $62.4M (+48%, partly LivePerson); adj. EBITDA −$20.7M, worse YoY; gross margin 34% vs 43%
  • OPEN (Opendoor): revenue +12%; net loss widened to $218M; gross margin 3.7%
  • NRDS (NerdWallet): revenue +11%; net income −43%; Q4 revenue guided ~−13% YoY
  • FIGS / LYFT: releases could not be retrieved

Larger movers for context

NET +12.6% (revenue +39%, raised guide), ABNB +11.4%, IREN +18%, AAOI +5% (revenue +128%). Lower: TEAM −16%, FIVN −17%, DKNG ~−18%, AXON ~−14%.
